name: ILLUSIA-2-Vita
description: Native PS Vita port of ILLUSIA 2, originally published by Gamevil for Android, built on soloader-boilerplate.
long_description: An ARM dynamic binary loader and native wrapper of **ILLUSIA 2** (Android v1.0.3, Gamevil) for the **PlayStation Vita** and **PlayStation TV**, using so-loader and vitaGL. The game's `libgameDSO.so` runs on the Vita, with the Android environment it needs provided by the port (JNI and Dalvik `ArrayObject` bridges, input and rendering HAL).
